title: Maximum Score After Splitting a String
summary: For a binary string s, calculate the highest score by dividing it into two non-empty parts, where the score is the count of zeros in the first part plus the count of ones in the second part.
statement: For a binary string s, calculate the highest score by dividing it into two non-empty parts, where the score is the count of zeros in the first part plus the count of ones in the second part.
constraints: Split the binary string into two non-empty parts.
Score is zeroes on the left plus ones on the right; return the maximum.
reference_solution:
def maximum_binary_split_score(s):
 right_ones=s.count('1');left_zeros=answer=0
 for char in s[:-1]:
  if char=='0':left_zeros+=1
  else:right_ones-=1
  answer=max(answer,left_zeros+right_ones)
 return answer
hints: Start with all ones counted on the right and no left zeroes.
Move the split across every position except the final character.
Update the appropriate count for the crossed character.
Every legal split is examined once with its exact score.

tests.explanation: Splitting after the first character gives one left zero plus four right ones.
Any valid split has no left zeroes; the earliest leaves three right ones.
